entries.en: A bit of patience would make this discussion much easier.
entries.zh: 多一点耐心会让这场讨论容易得多。

entries.en: A good few students stayed behind to ask questions.
entries.zh: 相当多的学生留了下来提问。

entries.en: We tried a good many routes before finding the quiet path.
entries.zh: 我们试了很多条路线，才找到那条安静的小路。

entries.en: A great many people helped to restore the old theatre.
entries.zh: 许许多多的人帮忙修复了那座老剧院。

entries.en: The noticeboard was covered with all kinds of colourful posters.
entries.zh: 公告栏上贴满了各种各样色彩鲜艳的海报。

entries.en: The workshop attracts people with all manner of creative interests.
entries.zh: 这间工作坊吸引了有着各种创作兴趣的人。

entries.en: We talked about exams, deadlines, and all that over lunch.
entries.zh: 午饭时，我们聊了考试、截止日期之类的事情。

entries.en: She packed notebooks, pencils, spare paper, and everything for the workshop.
entries.zh: 她为工作坊装好了笔记本、铅笔、备用纸张等等。

entries.en: The drawer is full of receipts, tickets, and the like.
entries.zh: 抽屉里塞满了收据、票据之类的东西。

entries.en: Don't grab any old cable; check that it fits first.
entries.zh: 别随便拿根线就用；先确认它能接上。

entries.en: At our costume party, anything goes as long as you feel comfortable.
entries.zh: 我们的化装舞会穿什么都行，只要你觉得自在。

entries.en: As ever, Maya arrived early and saved us a seat.
entries.zh: 玛雅照常早早到了，给我们留了个座位。

entries.en: He held the faded letter as if it might fall apart.
entries.zh: 他拿着那封褪色的信，好像它随时会散掉。

entries.en: Please contact your tutor or supervisor, as the case may be.
entries.zh: 请根据具体情况联系你的导师或指导老师。

entries.en: As things stand, we cannot promise to finish by Friday.
entries.zh: 按照现状来看，我们不能保证周五之前完成。

entries.meaningZh: 在…生长大的，地地道道的，…本地的
entries.en: She was born and bred in this small coastal town.
entries.zh: 她是在这座海滨小镇土生土长的。

entries.en: The flat is tiny, but then the rent is low.
entries.zh: 这套公寓很小，但另一方面，租金也低。

entries.en: I know most of the volunteers by name now.
entries.zh: 我现在知道大多数志愿者的名字了。

entries.en: He sent a short note by way of an apology.
entries.zh: 他寄来了一张简短的便条，作为道歉。

entries.en: Each and every applicant will receive a reply by email.
entries.zh: 每一位申请者都会收到电子邮件回复。

entries.en: If you need another day, fair enough; just let me know.
entries.zh: 如果你需要再多一天，行，告诉我就好。

entries.en: First things first: let's find somewhere dry to sit.
entries.zh: 重要的事先做：我们先找个干燥的地方坐下吧。

entries.en: Goodness knows where I left the spare key this time.
entries.zh: 天知道我这次又把备用钥匙落在哪里了。

entries.en: I was green with envy when I saw her sunny studio.
entries.zh: 看到她那间阳光充足的工作室，我羡慕得不得了。

entries.en: Knowing which question to ask is often half the battle.
entries.zh: 知道该问什么问题，往往就已经成功了一半。

entries.en: We can move the meeting online if necessary.
entries.zh: 如果有必要，我们可以把会议改到线上。

entries.term: if the worst comes to the worst
entries.en: If the worst comes to the worst, we can stay with my cousin.
entries.zh: 万一出现最坏的情况，我们可以住在我表亲家。

entries.en: We walked through the market in search of a quiet cafe.
entries.zh: 我们穿过市场，寻找一家安静的咖啡馆。

entries.en: The idea sounds simple in the abstract, but the details are difficult.
entries.zh: 这个想法在理论上听起来简单，但具体细节很难处理。

entries.en: The two proposals differ inasmuch as only one includes training.
entries.zh: 这两项提议有所不同，因为只有一项包含培训。

entries.en: The comparison is useful insofar as the two groups share similar circumstances.
entries.zh: 就这两组的情况相似而言，这个比较是有用的。

entries.en: Judging by the empty plates, everyone enjoyed the meal.
entries.zh: 从空盘子来看，大家都很喜欢这顿饭。

entries.en: Judging from her reply, she needs more time to decide.
entries.zh: 从她的回复来看，她还需要更多时间来决定。

entries.en: We have less and less space for new books.
entries.zh: 我们能放新书的空间越来越少了。

entries.en: It felt more like a friendly chat than an interview.
entries.zh: 那感觉更像一次友好的闲聊，而不是面试。

entries.en: I can barely read the map, much less navigate in the dark.
entries.zh: 我连地图都勉强看得懂，更不用说在黑暗中认路了。

entries.en: No fewer than thirty neighbours came to help with the cleanup.
entries.zh: 来帮忙清理的邻居不少于三十位。

entries.en: There was no lack of ideas during the planning session.
entries.zh: 筹划会上并不缺少点子。

entries.en: No matter how busy I am, I make time to call home.
entries.zh: 不管我有多忙，都会抽时间给家里打电话。

entries.en: No matter what happens tomorrow, we will face it together.
entries.zh: 不管明天发生什么，我们都会一起面对。

entries.en: Please choose no more than three photos for the display.
entries.zh: 请为这次展示选择至多三张照片。

entries.en: She offered us the spare room with no strings attached.
entries.zh: 她让我们使用那间空房，没有附带任何条件。

entries.en: We finished on time, no thanks to the printer that kept jamming.
entries.zh: 我们按时完成了，但这可不是那台老卡纸的打印机的功劳。

entries.en: The surprise guest was none other than our old music teacher.
entries.zh: 那位神秘嘉宾不是别人，正是我们以前的音乐老师。

entries.en: Not a few readers wrote to challenge the article's conclusion.
entries.zh: 不少读者写信质疑这篇文章的结论。

entries.en: The hotel breakfast was not a patch on my father's cooking.
entries.zh: 酒店的早餐远不如我父亲做的饭。

entries.en: A small grant is not to be sneezed at when funds are tight.
entries.zh: 经费紧张时，一笔小额资助也不容小觑。

entries.en: The trip would cost too much, not to speak of the time involved.
entries.zh: 这趟旅行会花太多钱，更不用说还要投入时间。

entries.en: Finishing the project with so little support was nothing short of remarkable.
entries.zh: 在支持这么少的情况下完成项目，简直称得上非凡。

entries.en: His latest excuse is of a piece with his earlier evasions.
entries.zh: 他最新的借口与之前那些闪烁其词的说法如出一辙。

entries.en: I have met her once or twice at the library.
entries.zh: 我在图书馆见过她一两次。

entries.en: Her refusal to support either side left her out on a limb.
entries.zh: 她拒绝支持任何一方，结果陷入了孤立无援的境地。

entries.en: Most editors are impatient, present company excepted, of course.
entries.zh: 大多数编辑都没什么耐心，当然，在座的各位除外。

entries.en: You can borrow the camera provided you return it by Monday.
entries.zh: 只要你周一之前还回来，就可以借这台相机。

entries.en: The concert can go ahead providing the rain stops soon.
entries.zh: 只要雨很快停下来，音乐会就能照常进行。

entries.en: Seeing as we're already here, let's look around the gallery.
entries.zh: 既然我们已经到这里了，就参观一下美术馆吧。

entries.en: Seeing that the bus was late, we decided to walk.
entries.zh: 既然公交车迟迟不来，我们决定步行。

entries.en: The stray dog was skin and bone when we first found it.
entries.zh: 我们最初发现那只流浪狗时，它瘦得皮包骨头。

entries.en: So much for the timetable; now let's discuss the budget.
entries.zh: 时间安排就先谈到这里；现在我们来讨论预算。

entries.en: If we can finish before lunch, so much the better.
entries.zh: 如果我们能在午饭前完成，那就更好了。

entries.en: You're welcome to use my spare desk, such as it is.
entries.zh: 欢迎你用我那张备用书桌，虽然它不怎么样。

entries.en: Talking of travel, have you booked your train ticket yet?
entries.zh: 说到出行，你订好火车票了吗？

entries.en: Please send me the draft, the sooner the better.
entries.zh: 请把草稿发给我，越快越好。

entries.en: The thing is, I promised to help my older sister that evening.
entries.zh: 问题是，我答应了那天晚上要帮我姐姐。

entries.en: Time flies when we spend an afternoon making music together.
entries.zh: 我们一起演奏音乐的时候，一下午的时间转眼就过去了。

entries.en: To be frank with you, this plan needs much more work.
entries.zh: 坦白地说，这个计划还需要下很大功夫完善。

entries.en: To be honest, I enjoyed the rehearsal more than the performance.
entries.zh: 老实说，比起正式演出，我更喜欢彩排。

entries.term: to make a long story short
entries.en: To make a long story short, we missed the train but still arrived on time.
entries.zh: 长话短说，我们错过了火车，但还是按时到了。

entries.en: The ending was disappointing, to put it mildly.
entries.zh: 说得婉转些，这个结局令人失望。

entries.en: The house needs new wiring, to say nothing of a new roof.
entries.zh: 这座房子需要重新布线，更不用说还要换个新屋顶。

entries.meaningZh: 实话跟你说吧,说实在话,老实说
entries.en: To tell you the truth, I forgot we had arranged to meet.
entries.zh: 实话跟你说吧，我忘了我们约好要见面。

entries.en: The noise increased to the extent that we could barely hear each other.
entries.zh: 噪声越来越大，以至于我们几乎听不清对方说话。

entries.en: I am going to finish this draft before dinner.
entries.zh: 我打算在晚饭前完成这份草稿。

entries.meaningZh: 谁也说不准；没有人能确定答案。
entries.en: When the repairs will be finished is anyone's guess.
entries.zh: 修理工作什么时候能完成，谁也说不准。

entries.meaningZh: 几乎等于；实际效果上无异于。
entries.en: Without a working key, the locked cupboard is as good as useless.
entries.zh: 没有一把能用的钥匙，这个锁着的柜子实际上就等于没用了。

entries.meaningZh: 袒露内心；显露一个人深藏的感受或真实自我。
entries.en: I find it hard to bare my soul to someone I have just met.
entries.zh: 我很难向刚认识的人袒露内心。

entries.meaningZh: 天生适合或具备从事某事的性格、能力；常用于否定句表示不适合。
entries.en: I don't think I am cut out for sales.
entries.zh: 我觉得自己不是做销售的料。

entries.en: We were in awe of the skill on display.
entries.zh: 我们对展示出来的技艺赞叹不已。

entries.meaningZh: 惹上麻烦；因做错事而可能受到责备。
entries.en: He was in hot water after forgetting to book the team's room.
entries.zh: 他忘了给团队订房，因而惹上了麻烦。

entries.meaningZh: 暗中打着什么主意；正在策划某件可能不太正当的事。
entries.en: They were up to something, judging by their sudden silence.
entries.zh: 从他们突然安静下来这点看，他们在暗中打着什么主意。

entries.term: bring out the best in somebody
entries.meaningZh: 激发某人最好的一面；使某人的优点或能力充分发挥出来。
entries.en: A patient coach can bring out the best in a nervous player.
entries.zh: 有耐心的教练能让紧张的球员发挥出最好的一面。

entries.meaningZh: 发展到关键关头；矛盾集中显现、到了必须处理的地步。
entries.en: The dispute may come to a head at Friday's meeting.
entries.zh: 这场争执可能在周五的会议上发展到必须处理的关头。

entries.meaningZh: 凸显出来；从背景中变得强烈而显眼。
entries.en: Different priorities can come to the fore during a crisis.
entries.zh: 危机期间，不同的优先事项可能会凸显出来。

entries.meaningZh: 别误会我的意思；用于防止对方把自己的话理解得过头或理解反了。
entries.en: Don't get me wrong; I like the idea, but the timing worries me.
entries.zh: 别误会，我喜欢这个想法，只是担心时机不合适。

entries.meaningZh: 给出暗示；不直接说破地透露想法或意愿。
entries.en: You could drop a hint that you'd prefer a smaller celebration.
entries.zh: 你可以暗示一下，说自己更想办个小一点的庆祝活动。

entries.meaningZh: 未达到某种标准或期望；比参照对象差、不足。
entries.en: Even a careful plan can fall short of expectations.
entries.zh: 即使是周密的计划，也可能达不到预期。

entries.meaningZh: 有发言权；能够对决定发表意见并产生一定影响。
entries.en: Students should have a say in how the common room is used.
entries.zh: 学生应该对公共休息室如何使用有发言权。

entries.meaningZh: 不落下风；面对对手或挑战仍能应付自如。
entries.en: With a little practice, she could hold her own in the debate.
entries.zh: 稍加练习，她就能在辩论中不落下风。

entries.meaningZh: 从新的角度；以不同于以前的方式看待。
entries.en: Her explanation helped me see the disagreement in a new light.
entries.zh: 她的解释帮助我从新的角度看待这场分歧。

entries.meaningZh: 将要发生的；在未来等待着某人的。
entries.en: We had no idea what surprises were in store for us.
entries.zh: 我们不知道前面还有什么惊喜在等着我们。

entries.meaningZh: 理性看待事情的轻重与全貌；不让局部的挫折压倒整体判断。
entries.en: Talking to a friend helps me keep things in perspective.
entries.zh: 和朋友聊聊能帮助我从全局理性看待事情。

entries.meaningZh: 在不理想的情况下尽力应付；尽量利用现有条件。
entries.en: The weather was awful, but we decided to make the best of it.
entries.zh: 天气很糟，但我们决定尽量利用现有条件。

entries.en: No hard feelings if you choose someone else for the role.
entries.zh: 如果你选别人来担任这个角色，我也不会有怨气。

entries.en: Dust had gathered in all the nooks and crannies of the cabinet.
entries.zh: 柜子的各个犄角旮旯都积了灰。

entries.meaningZh: 一个字也不透露；严守秘密。
entries.en: Please do not breathe a word of our surprise party.
entries.zh: 关于我们筹备的惊喜派对，请一个字也别透露。

entries.en: With more practice, we might stand a chance of winning.
entries.zh: 多练习一些，我们或许就有机会获胜。

entries.meaningZh: 觉得受到冒犯；因某人的话或行为而不快。
entries.en: Please don't take offence; I only meant to offer a suggestion.
entries.zh: 请别觉得受到了冒犯，我只是想提个建议。

entries.meaningZh: 基本原理和实际操作细节。
entries.en: This guide explains the nuts and bolts of setting up a small club.
entries.zh: 这份指南讲解了创办小型俱乐部的基本原理和实际操作细节。

entries.meaningZh: 出现转机；经历困难后开始好转。
entries.en: After months of delays, the project finally began to turn a corner.
entries.zh: 经历数月的拖延后，这个项目终于开始出现转机。
